title: Text Characterization Toolkit
reasoning: The paper introduces a toolkit to study properties of datasets and the influence of those properties on models' behavior, including identifying 'potentially harmful biases' and 'undesired, biased behavior'. It provides a use case specifically titled 'Gender Bias in Co-reference Resolution Models' (Section B.2). Identifying and analyzing such biases is a direct component of evaluating ethical aspects of AI systems, particularly fairness.
